opportunities.title: Coral-Lattice Sandal Midsole Design
opportunities.description: I’m developing a sandal that features a 3D-printed midsole inspired by the interlocking geometry of coral polyps. The design must feel natural underfoot for everyday walking and casual wear, distributing pressure evenly across the whole foot rather than concentrating support only at the heel or arch. I’m working with a standard adult foot profile, so there’s no custom scan involved—just a well-balanced, ergonomic shape that can drop straight into typical men’s and women’s lasts. You’ll translate the coral motif into a printable lattice that blends cushioning and stability. Think flexible TPU or a similarly resilient material; the goal is a sole that rebounds lightly, keeps weight down, and survives repeated flexing. I’m comfortable evaluating files in Rhino, Grasshopper, Fusion 360, or SolidWorks, so use whichever platform lets you parametrically refine cell size, wall thickness, and infill gradients. Deliverables • 3D CAD file of the full-length midsole (STL and native format) • A brief spec sheet noting lattice parameters, recommended print orientation, and material guidelines • Rendered visuals that illustrate the underside pattern and a cross-section of the internal geometry • Optional but valued: a basic FEA snapshot or compression test simulation showing even pressure distribution across the footbed Acceptance The lattice should compress smoothly under light body weight, rebound without noticeable “bottoming out,” and maintain structural integrity at 2 mm minimum wall thickness. I’ll test by printing a sample in TPU—if the sole feels balanced from heel to toe and shows no weak spots after flex cycles, the job is done.

opportunities.title: Campaña Viral de Eventos Infantiles
opportunities.description: Somos una compañía especializada en animación a domicilio para niños y quiero lanzar una campaña publicitaria que logre dos cosas muy claras: 1. Lograr reconocimiento de marca en nuestra localidad objetivo. 2. Generar un flujo constante de consultas por WhatsApp o llamada para nuestras fiestas de cumpleaños en casa. Lo que necesito de ti: • Estrategia creativa: ideas virales que conecten con padres y madres de nuestra ciudad y reflejen la diversión y la tranquilidad de contratar animadores profesionales en casa. • Configuración y gestión de anuncios en las plataformas que tengan mejor rendimiento para este público (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok; estoy abierto a otras si lo justificas). • Segmentación geográfica precisa para nuestra localidad y optimización diaria/semanal de presupuesto, pujas y audiencias. • Redacción de copys persuasivos y diseño de piezas visuales o briefing claro para mi diseñador. • Calendario de publicaciones orgánicas que complemente la pauta pagada y fomente interacciones. • Informe quincenal con métricas clave (alcance, CTR, costo por lead, mensajes recibidos) y recomendaciones de mejora. Acepto propuestas que incluyan pruebas A/B y formatos cortos tipo Reels para maximizar la viralidad — en especial si aportan ejemplos de campañas infantiles exitosas. Quiero ver resultados medibles en las primeras cuatro semanas. Si tienes experiencia impulsando negocios locales de eventos, guarderías o productos infantiles, menciónalo; será un plus. Estoy listo para empezar cuanto antes y brindaré acceso a nuestras cuentas publicitarias y material gráfico existente.

opportunities.title: Diseñador Gráfico para Campañas de Impacto en Redes Sociales y Offline

opportunities.description: I need support increasing the number of authentic reviews on a single ASIN in my Amazon store. To stay fully within Amazon policy, I only want to leverage the built-in “Request a Review” button inside Seller Central—no external messaging, no incentives, and no grey-area tactics. Here’s what I expect: • Identify every recent eligible order for the chosen product and trigger the Request a Review action at the appropriate timing (5–30 days post-delivery). • Keep a simple log showing the date each request was sent so I can track performance. • Advise me on a light workflow or automation that will let me continue this process after the project ends. Success will be measured by the successful submission of review requests for all eligible orders during the engagement period and receipt of your activity log. If you already use tools that can streamline this task and still keep it 100 % Amazon-compliant, let me know in your proposal.

opportunities.title: Cross-Platform Hospital Tycoon Game
opportunities.description: ATTENTION: PLEASE ENSURE YOU READ THE PROJECT REQUIREMENTS AND UNDERSTAND THE ASSETS ART. ANY BOT BID WILL AUTOMATICALLY BE REJECTED Seem this platform doesnt have anyone that have enough ability to prove their skills..... ------ >To be verified your ability to work: Please make a prototype demo video and send to me through chat. ANY BID WITHOUT PROOF OF PROTOTYPE WOULD BE REJECTED.. Thank you. --------- I want to turn the pixel-art pack at https://gainpips.itch.io/hospital-staff-patients into a full mobile hospital-management tycoon for both Android and iPhone/iPad. The art set should be used exactly as it is, so the code and UI need to respect its scale, palette, and proportions. Core gameplay revolves around three intertwined loops: players build and expand new hospital rooms, hire and schedule doctors, nurses, and other staff, then treat incoming patients while continually upgrading equipment to keep satisfaction and profits rising. Smooth drag-and-drop room placement, incremental unlocking of facilities, and clear resource dashboards are essential to make that flow satisfying on touch screens. I am happy with any well-documented engine—Unity, Godot, or a comparable cross-platform framework—as long as performance is solid on mid-range phones. Deliverables • Playable builds: Android APK + iOS TestFlight/IPA • Complete, compile-ready project source with comments • Brief setup guide so I can open, tweak, and export future versions myself Acceptance criteria will be a fully functional tutorial level that demonstrates room construction, staff hiring, and at least one diagnosis-treatment-discharge cycle while keeping the original asset visuals intact.

opportunities.title: Ingeniero Frigorista para Diseño de Refrigeración Comercial de Supe...
opportunities.description: RAC Retail Group, una empresa especializada en el diseño, suministro e instalación de supermercados y tiendas de alimentos en EE. UU., El Caribe y otros mercados, busca un ingeniero o proyectista frigorista para una colaboración recurrente. Se iniciará con un proyecto de prueba pagado enfocado en una tienda pequeña. El alcance del proyecto de prueba incluye: - Cálculo de cargas térmicas para cámaras (conservación y congelación) y muebles refrigerados. - Selección de equipos, como centrales o unidades condensadoras y evaporadores. - Dimensionado de tuberías (succión, descarga y líquido). - Creación de planos de distribución frigorífica utilizando AutoCAD. - Elaboración de un listado de materiales (material takeoff) detallado por partida, incluyendo tubería, aislamiento, válvulas, accesorios y soportes. Los requisitos clave para este rol son: - Experiencia demostrable en refrigeración comercial o industrial, específicamente en supermercados o cámaras frigoríficas. - Dominio de AutoCAD y software de selección de equipos (ej. Coolselector, Bitzer, Copeland u otros). - Familiaridad con diversas marcas y normativas (europeas, estadounidenses u otras), con la capacidad de adaptarse a las especificaciones de cada proyecto. - Habilidades de comunicación fluida y disponibilidad para reuniones online puntuales. En la propuesta, se solicita incluir: 1. Dos o tres proyectos similares realizados previamente. 2. Los tipos de refrigerantes con los que se ha trabajado (hfc/hfo, co2, amoniaco). 3. La tarifa por proyecto o por hora. Si el proyecto de prueba es exitoso, se ofrecerá la oportunidad de trabajo continuo en múltiples proyectos. Categoría: Ingeniería y Arquitectura Subcategoría: Diseño industrial ¿Qué necesitas?: Crear un diseño a partir de un boceto

opportunities.title: Airbnb & rooming house Property VA Needed
opportunities.description: I run a small portfolio of shared rooms and whole-home Airbnb listings across Melbourne and I need a steady pair of hands to take over day-to-day guest and resident communications. You will have full control of all messages, bookings, and follow-ups so that every enquiry is answered promptly and every stay runs smoothly. Key flow of work • Monitor and reply to Airbnb, email, Flatmates.com.au, and Facebook messages throughout the Melbourne day and evening. • Issue check-in details, handle reservation changes, leave thoughtful reviews, and keep occupancy calendars tidy. • Coordinate cleaners between stays and schedule regular gardening so properties stay guest-ready. • Arrange room inspections, log repairs in our shared Google Sheet, chase up trades, and send polite rent reminders. If an urgent problem arises—lockout, leak, or anything affecting safety—call or message me first before taking action so we can decide the next step together. The ideal fit writes clear, friendly English, knows their way around the Airbnb host dashboard, and is available 7 days per week for quick responses (about 15–20 hours spread across the week). Reliability is critical, so we will start with a paid trial and roll into an ongoing arrangement once we see a good rhythm. All records live in Google Sheets and most coordination happens in WhatsApp and email, so you will need a solid internet connection and the discipline to keep everything up to date. If you can bring that level of care, I look forward to working with you long term.

opportunities.title: 3D Browser Remake of Video Game
opportunities.description: I need a faithful 3D recreation of the entire game shown in this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Igh4QhpT81w. Every feature, level, mechanic, and character that appears there has to make it into the browser version so players feel as if they are stepping straight into a three-dimensional copy of the original. Platform The game must run smoothly inside a modern web browser—no installs, just click-to-play. A WebGL export from Unity or an equivalent HTML5 framework such as Three.js or Babylon.js is fine, provided performance remains solid on standard desktop machines. Visual & Audio Fidelity All characters, environments, animations, UI elements, and sound effects should match the video as closely as legally possible. Where assets need to be rebuilt from scratch, keep proportions, colors, and timing identical so returning players instantly recognize every detail. Core Expectations • Full gameplay loop, including every power-up, enemy pattern, scoring rule, and level transition • Responsive controls mapped for keyboard (WASD/arrow keys) and mouse where appropriate • Consistent frame rate at typical desktop resolutions • Clean, maintainable code and clearly organized project files Deliverables 1. Playable Web build hosted on a test URL 2. Complete source project (Unity, Three.js, or similar) with all assets and documentation 3. Brief setup guide for local builds and future updates I’ll supply additional reference captures once development begins and will test each milestone directly in the browser.

opportunities.title: Textured GLB Mesh for 3DVista
opportunities.description: I have both E57 and LAS point-clouds of a site with several building that I want to turn into a 3D digital twin inside 3DVista. What I need from you is a single GLB that contains a fully textured 3D mesh generated from the entire scan area—not just key rooms or simplified objects. Visual fidelity should be balanced: detailed enough to look good during standard walkthroughs in 3DVista, yet light enough to keep navigation smooth on typical desktop hardware. You are free to use your preferred workflow—RealityCapture, Blender, CloudCompare, MeshLab, or similar—as long as the result opens flawlessly in 3DVista with textures properly referenced. Deliverable • One GLB file, texture-packed, covering the full scan area, optimized for smooth viewing in 3DVista.

opportunities.description: HIRING ONE ELITE FULL-SERVICE MARKETING AGENCY SIX BUSINESS VENTURES | ONE MARKETING PARTNER | LONG-TERM STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP We are seeking ONE exceptional, highly experienced, full-service marketing company to manage marketing, branding, advertising, lead generation, and business development across six ventures. We require an established agency with a proven track record, a multidisciplinary team, and the resources to execute sophisticated campaigns across multiple industries. This is a long-term opportunity for the right marketing company. OUR SIX BUSINESS VENTURES 01 STEEL ONE https://steelone.us - Corporate branding and market positioning - B2B lead generation and digital advertising - Strategic partnerships, customer acquisition, and business development 02 SPRINTER https://sprinter-3364.vercel.app/ - Brand development and market positioning - Customer acquisition, digital campaigns, and lead generation - Strategic business growth 03 CONCORD PACIFIC INVESTMENTS https://concord-pacific-investments.vercel.app/ - Corporate and investment-sector marketing - Investor-oriented brand positioning and qualified prospect generation - Corporate visibility and strategic business relationships - All investment-related marketing must comply with applicable advertising and securities regulations 04 PARADISE CASTING https://paradise-casting.vercel.app/ - Brand awareness and market expansion - Targeted digital advertising and social media marketing - Audience and customer acquisition, strategic partnerships, and lead generation 05 SMARTMAT™ — INNOVATIVE SMART HOME TECHNOLOGY SmartMat™ - A Smarter, Safer Home SmartMat™ is an innovative smart doormat concept combining home security, connectivity, convenience, and entertainment. Features presented include a built-in security camera, live video and two-way communication, voice interaction, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, smartphone integration, music and audio, an integrated speaker, and heat/smoke detection with early fire alerts. - Develop a comprehensive product launch strategy and consumer brand recognition - Identify target markets, distributors, and retail or commercial partners - Create product demonstrations, promotional videos, and digital advertising - Build e-commerce, customer acquisition, and prelaunch demand-generation campaigns - Support national and international expansion The agency should demonstrate experience in consumer products, smart home technology, electronics, or technology startups. Safety, fire-detection, and security claims must be verified before publication. 06 MASTER CRAFT INTERNATIONAL https://master-craft-international.vercel.app/ - Corporate marketing strategy and professional brand positioning - Target market identification, digital advertising, SEO, and lead generation - Customer acquisition, strategic partnerships, and business development - Review the company's website, products, and services before proposing a tailored strategy CENTRALIZED MARKETING MANAGEMENT ONE agency must manage ALL SIX ventures under ONE master agreement. - One dedicated senior account director and complete professional marketing team - Individual strategies for each business with centralized coordination - Paid media, SEO, social media, content, brand development, and public relations - B2B/B2C lead generation, product commercialization, CRM, and automation - Separate, transparent budgets for each venture - Weekly updates and monthly executive performance reports AGENCY QUALIFICATIONS - Preferably 10+ years of professional marketing experience - Established company with a qualified, multidisciplinary team - Proven management of multiple brands or business accounts - Strong U.S. market expertise and international capabilities - Successful corporate and consumer campaigns, including new product launches - Verifiable case studies, client references, and acquisition results - Advanced digital advertising, conversion optimization, and reporting expertise Individual freelancers and inexperienced agencies are not suitable for this engagement. REQUIRED 90-DAY ACTION PLAN Days 1–30 | Research & Strategy - Audit all six ventures, websites, and existing marketing assets - Research markets, competitors, and target customers - Develop tailored strategies, budgets, and measurable KPIs Days 31–60 | Implementation - Launch approved advertising and lead-generation campaigns - Begin SEO, content, conversion, and brand-awareness initiatives - Prepare SmartMat™ product-launch marketing and centralized reporting Days 61–90 | Optimization & Growth - Analyze campaign performance and optimize spend and lead quality - Assess acquisition costs and campaign return on investment - Present a six-month growth plan for the portfolio FINANCIAL PROPOSAL Submit competitive pricing with agency management fees and advertising expenditures quoted separately. - Total monthly agency management fee covering all six ventures - Recommended advertising budget for each venture - Initial setup costs, implementation fees, and assigned personnel - Optional performance-based compensation and proposed contract terms - Estimated implementation schedule APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS - Company profile: name, website, location, years in operation, and team size - Relevant experience managing multiple brands and complex campaigns - At least three verifiable case studies with measurable results - Initial assessment of all six ventures and their marketing opportunities - Proposed cross-portfolio strategy and operating structure - SmartMat™ experience in product launches, electronics, or smart home technology - Dedicated account director and assigned specialists - Detailed financial proposal, KPI framework, and client references OUR OBJECTIVE We seek a sophisticated marketing partner capable of supporting the growth and commercialization of multiple businesses. We expect professionalism, creativity, accountability, strategic execution, and measurable results. The selected agency will work with executive management and may receive additional ventures as our portfolio expands. ONE AGENCY. SIX BUSINESS VENTURES. ONE CENTRALIZED MARKETING TEAM. ONE LONG-TERM PARTNERSHIP. ONLY ESTABLISHED, HIGHLY EXPERIENCED, FULL-SERVICE MARKETING COMPANIES SHOULD APPLY. Generic proposals will not be considered.

opportunities.title: Dotdigital Newsletter Template Creation
opportunities.description: I want to add a branded, reusable newsletter template to my Dotdigital account so I can share ongoing company news without rebuilding the layout each time. The template needs to: • Live inside Dotdigital (built with either EasyEditor blocks or custom HTML/CSS that plays nicely with the platform). • Highlight a headline news section and a clearly defined “Team Updates” area, with room for supplementary blurbs, images and links. • Render perfectly on mobile and desktop, passing the usual email-client litmus tests. • Be easy for non-technical staff to swap text, images and colours while keeping fonts, padding and overall structure locked down to brand guidelines. Please hand over: 1. The finished Dotdigital template file or direct import into my workspace. 2. A brief usage note or loom walkthrough showing where to edit each content block. If you have questions about our hex colours, logo assets or font files, let me know and I’ll supply them right away.

opportunities.title: Virtual Personal Assistant Needed (USA Applicants Only)
opportunities.description: My calendar fills up fast, and my inbox follows suit, so I’m bringing in a virtual assistant who can keep both under control while helping with day-to-day research and bookings. Here’s the core of what you’ll handle: • Calendar & appointments – block, reschedule, and send invites with priority given to work meetings and deadlines. I use Google Calendar and Microsoft Teams, so you’ll work inside those tools. • Inbox & messages – triage daily mail in Gmail, draft replies for my approval, flag anything time-sensitive, and archive the noise. • Research & bookings – find data or service options I ask for (flights, hotel rooms, vendor quotes, quick market facts) and complete the booking or prep a short brief. Requirement: This position is open exclusively to applicants within the USA. Access & workflow You’ll have delegated access that lets you draft but not send emails without my OK. For messages, a shared Slack channel or WhatsApp chat will keep quick questions moving. Success looks like a clean inbox at the end of each day, a calendar that never double-books, and well-documented research ready when I need it. If you’re organized, responsive, and comfortable with Google Workspace, Outlook, Zoom, and standard travel-booking sites—and you're based in the USA—I’d love to hear how you’d approach this.

opportunities.title: After Effects masking and motion tracking
opportunities.description: I have a series of clips where the original setting no longer fits the story, so I need a skilled After Effects editor who can precisely mask the talent and composite them into believable indoor or outdoor locations. The end result should feel as though the footage was captured on location—matching lighting, grain, shadows, and camera movement so the swap is invisible to the viewer. You’ll get: • Clean, high-resolution source footage with alpha-friendly framing • Reference stills for the target environment and mood • Any additional plates or HDRIs I can supply to help with reflections and lighting cues What I’m looking for: • Solid experience delivering film-level or commercial VFX comps in After Effects (RotoBrush, Mocha, 3D Camera Tracker, and color-matching tools should be second nature) • A short note highlighting similar shots you have tackled—no need for lengthy proposals, just point me to work that proves you can integrate live action into realistic spaces convincingly Deliverables: 1. Final 10-bit ProRes files with new backgrounds in place 2. The organised .aep project with all linked assets so I can tweak if needed 3. A quick turnaround version for review, plus one revision pass included If you excel at tight matte work and photo-real composites, let’s make these scenes look like we were really there.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40790111, publicado hace 5 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 30 - 250.

opportunities.title: Build Bilingual AI Real Estate Sales Agent
opportunities.description: Developer Needed: AI Automation Engineer to Build an Intelligent Sales Agent for a US Real Estate Company PRESTIA AI | Fixed-Scope and Fixed-Price Execution Contract 1. Executive Summary PRESTIA AI invites AI and automation developers and specialized firms to submit technical and financial proposals to implement a fully operational Intelligent Sales System for a real estate company in Florida, USA. The project aims to develop an intelligent sales agent supporting both English and Spanish. The agent will engage with leads, qualify and categorize them, record their data in a CRM system, book appointments, send confirmations and notifications, and escalate cases requiring human intervention to designated staff. PRESTIA AI seeks a fully integrated, testable, maintainable, and scalable solution, not merely an experimental chatbot or demo prototype. The system must be well-documented, secure, manageable, and independent of the developer's personal account. 2. Project Objectives The project aims to: Improve response times to prospective leads. Provide effective automated conversations in English and Spanish. Collect, qualify, and classify lead data according to approved business rules. Log lead details and interactions into the CRM system. Automate appointment scheduling and dispatch confirmations/notifications. Minimize lost sales opportunities and optimize follow-up management. Establish a clear escalation protocol for complex cases requiring human intervention. Build a scalable system designed for future operations, maintenance, and expansion. 3. Scope of Work 3.1 Multilingual AI Agent The bidder must design and implement an intelligent sales agent with the following functionalities: Conduct conversations, qualification, follow-ups, and appointment bookings in English and Spanish. Automatically detect the lead's language and respond accordingly, while allowing manual language selection. Handle incoming inquiries via website and official WhatsApp Business channels. Rely strictly on verified company, real estate, and service information to prevent hallucination of prices, specs, or availability. Collect and qualify lead data based on custom rules provided by PRESTIA AI. Maintain conversation context and lead data during language switching or transition between qualification and booking stages. Escalate unsupported inquiries or complex scenarios to human representatives based on clear routing logic. 3.2 CRM Integration & Appointment Management Scope includes: Capturing leads and logging key interactions into the designated CRM. Creating and updating records while preventing duplicate entries caused by re-triggered events. Integrating with calendar systems (e.g., Google Calendar) to verify real-time availability prior to confirming bookings. Preventing double-booking and sending bi-lingual scheduling confirmations/notifications to responsible teams. Supporting cancellations and rescheduling if included in agreed terms. 3.3 Technical Integration & Automation The bidder must build required integrations across: Website & lead collection forms WhatsApp Business API (official provider) CRM & Calendar systems Notification channels Technical requirements: Implement error logging and automatic retry mechanisms for failed API calls. Secure API keys, enforce proper access controls, and safeguard lead data. Deliver a system fully operational, manageable, and maintainable without reliance on personal developer accounts. Low-Code/No-Code platforms, custom APIs, or off-the-shelf AI services may be used provided they fulfill requirements, offer ease of management, and document all costs clearly. Note: All tools, CRM selections, integration methods, and estimated operational fees must be disclosed upfront. No paid additions or subscriptions may be purchased without prior written approval from PRESTIA AI. 4. Live Demo & Pre-Selection Prototype Shortlisted candidates must deliver a Live Demo or limited prototype demonstrating core functionality in both English and Spanish, including: Live conversations with language auto-detection and manual switching. Lead qualification, data capture, and mock/live CRM record creation. Real-time availability checking and appointment confirmation. Graceful handling of unknown data and seamless handoff to human agents. Evaluation focuses on data accuracy, context retention, and functional execution rather than UI aesthetics alone. Full project work will not be built for free; demo scope, duration, and any nominal costs must be agreed upon in advance. 5. Key Deliverables The bidder must deliver: Fully operational, production-ready system per agreed scope. English/Spanish AI Sales Agent operating under specified workflows. Complete automation flows, custom code, and configuration files (flagging non-exportable components). Live integrations across Website, WhatsApp, CRM, Calendar, and Alerts. Technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and workflow maps. User operations & troubleshooting guide for routine maintenance and setting updates. Itemized breakdown of software tools, API subscriptions, and operational expenses. Verified testing reports proving successful execution in both languages. Formal handover session and practical training. Transfer of all system access rights, accounts, and configuration files according to ownership agreements. 6. Acceptance Criteria & Testing Prior to development, testing scenarios and pass criteria will be defined in writing. Testing must cover: Bi-lingual interactions via Web and WhatsApp. Lead qualification, CRM record generation, and deduplication logic. Valid booking flow, calendar synchronization, and conflict rejection. Automated alert dispatches and human handoff routing. Error recovery, API retry behavior, and security access controls. Project acceptance requires written approval from PRESTIA AI after passing all test benchmarks. 7. Timeline, Pricing & Payment Terms Timeline: Bidder must provide a realistic milestone plan covering development, testing, and handover. Pricing: Fixed total price for execution, strictly separating developer fees from third-party operational/subscription costs. Payment Terms: Tied directly to reviewable, milestone-based deliverables. Scope Changes: Scope adjustments require prior written approval for both cost and extended timeline. 8. Warranty & Technical Support 90-Day Warranty: Includes a 90-calendar-day warranty period starting from final written acceptance to fix bugs, settings, or broken integrations at no extra cost. Exclusions: Excludes new feature requests, scope changes, or third-party service outages unrelated to original implementation flaws. SLA: Bidders must state response times, support hours, and post-warranty maintenance rates in their proposal. 9. Intellectual Property & Confidentiality All custom code, workflows, and assets created for the project belong exclusively to PRESTIA AI upon completion. Bidders must disclose pre-existing IP, open-source libraries, and third-party tools used. Strict non-disclosure of PRESTIA AI client and lead data is required. All client accounts must remain under PRESTIA AI control. 10. Developer Qualifications Required experience includes: Proven track record building AI Agents connected to live backend systems. Multilingual conversation design (English & Spanish). Hands-on API integrations, Low-Code/No-Code workflow development. Official WhatsApp Business API setup. CRM & Calendar integrations, robust error handling, and data security. 11. Proposal Structure Requirements Proposals must contain: Bidder Profile: Legal name, contact info, relevant portfolio. Understanding of Scope: Brief summary of project goals and scope. Proposed Solution: System architecture and technical design. Tooling & Stack: CRM, WhatsApp provider, Calendar, and logic stack selections. Fixed Price & Operational Costs: Execution fee breakdown vs. monthly third-party running costs. Implementation Timeline: Milestones, testing phases, and delivery dates. Testing & QA Plan: Methodology for bi-lingual validation and CRM/Calendar checks. Demo Scope & Cost: Scope of pre-selection demo (if applicable). Warranty & SLA Terms: Confirmation of 90-day warranty and support response times. IP & Confidentiality: Agreement to ownership transfer and data security terms. 12. Proposal Evaluation Criteria Evaluation CriteriaWeightProven experience building live AI Agents & Automations20%Technical solution quality, scalability & maintainability20%Bilingual deployment experience (English / Spanish)15%Quality of CRM, WhatsApp, and Calendar integrations10%Execution, testing, documentation, and delivery plan10%Data security, API protection, and permission management10%Live Demo or working prototype quality10%Competitive pricing and optimized running costs5% Priority is given to solutions offering high stability, seamless bilingual performance, low operational overhead, and full ownership transfer rather than lowest price alone. 13. General Terms & Final Output Full development begins only upon written signature of technical, financial, and scope terms. The final deliverable is an intelligent, bilingual real estate sales system operating in Florida, backed by full documentation and a 90-day execution warranty.

opportunities.title: FiveM Enhanced MLO/YMAP Developer — Conversion, Conflict Resolution, Consolidation, Optimize and In-Game Testing
opportunities.description: Fixed total budget: USD 500 for the agreed full scope, not per group. We need an experienced FiveM mapping developer to prepare our existing YMAPs and associated assets for FiveM Enhanced. This project covers existing map files and their required models, textures, collisions, archetypes, occlusion and LOD data. It does not involve general framework development, gameplay systems or creating new interiors from scratch. You must already have a working GTA V Enhanced installation, FiveM Enhanced test environment, CodeWalker and the required conversion tools before accepting. Required work 1. Convert assets for FiveM Enhanced - Convert applicable Legacy models and textures using FiveM Alchemist or an appropriate verified workflow. - Preserve the required YMAP, YTYP, collision and other supporting map data. - Verify that the resulting assets load correctly in FiveM Enhanced. - Report conversion failures or unavailable source files promptly. Conversion logs or a folder named stream_enhanced alone do not establish completion. 2. Merge and organize map resources Consolidate the supplied maps and assets into: - x6-businessmaps - x6-shadowmaps - x6-governmentmaps - x6-housingmaps - x6-jobmaps - x6-leisuremaps - x6-worldmaps - x6-mapdata for agreed shared mapdata and compatibility files. The target is one working map resource per category, with a correct top-level manifest, required registrations and an organized streaming structure. Identify any technical or asset-protection restriction before proceeding. Do not simply move unchanged individual resource folders under a category folder and describe them as merged. 3. Resolve map and asset conflicts Identify and resolve: - Duplicate filenames with different contents. - Conflicting map definitions and archetypes. - Overlapping placements and map edits. - Collision, occlusion, LOD and streaming conflicts. - Conflicts between category groups and shared mapdata. Removing duplicate filenames is not necessarily conflict resolution. Preserve the required changes from each affected map. Do not select a conflicting version solely by alphabetical order, load order or file size. Document the resolution and validate it in game. Do not remove maps, replace businesses or choose between overlapping alternatives without our approval. 4. Repair and optimize Within the agreed asset inventory: - Fix missing models, props and textures. - Address texture loss, flickering, incorrect collisions and visibility issues. - Review and repair LODs, draw distances, map bounds and lighting where needed. - Optimize textures and models where justified, preserving acceptable visual quality. - Clean unnecessary files from the delivery. - Verify compatibility when all supplied groups run together. Any required UK-style texture or signage changes must be listed against specific assets before the fixed scope is agreed. In-game validation is mandatory Before submitting a category as completed: - Load it on a working FiveM Enhanced test server. - Visit every included map location. - Check models, textures, collisions, lighting and visibility. - Inspect repaired areas from different distances and angles. - Check relevant server/client errors and streaming warnings. - Test it with its required map dependencies. Before final delivery, test all completed categories together. For performance claims, provide before-and-after measurements using the same hardware, settings, locations and conditions. CodeWalker inspection, automated reports and videos of files opening are not substitutes for FiveM Enhanced testing. AI and automation may assist the work, but the developer remains responsible for inspecting and validating the results. Scope and delivery We will agree a dated inventory of included maps/assets, required repairs, exclusions and delivery dates before implementation. We may initially share only a small batch for qualification. Further groups follow after that batch is validated. The initial batch does not redefine the full-project budget. Work document: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1flO2glbX3TW3HPoyxrFSscfGvPfFdJvmt8ExuxPz6NI/edit?gid=860763218 Each delivery must include: - One ZIP containing complete installation-ready resource folders. - Correct manifests and required map files. - Installation instructions, dependencies and start order. - A file-level change list and conflict-resolution record. - A per-location test checklist with relevant in-game screenshots or recordings. - A clear list of any unresolved issues. Blocked or untested work must be identified as incomplete. Do not silently delete assets or return an untested pack as finished work. General server/framework development and unrelated scripts are outside scope. Existing asset dependencies must be identified and preserved; any required script changes must be raised before implementation. Your proposal must confirm 1. Your experience with FiveM Enhanced YMAPs and associated assets. 2. That your game, tools and test environment are already operational. 3. How you resolve conflicting collision and occlusion files. 4. How you verify conversion and test every supplied map location. 5. Your delivery schedule for the qualification batch, remaining groups and final combined test. 6. That you have reviewed the inventory and can complete the agreed scope for USD 500, with any exclusions stated before acceptance. Relevant experience and verifiable results are required. Generic bids will not be considered.

El objetivo es crear contenido visualmente atractivo y entretenido que capture la esencia y la energía de cada canción, siguiendo la estética de las "RAVEN Ruin Sessions". El editor deberá tener la capacidad de adaptar la edición a las vibras específicas de cada pieza musical, asegurando una experiencia inmersiva para el espectador. opportunities.title: Realistic Folding Phone Dummy Build
opportunities.description: I have a working 3D concept for a folding-screen phone and now need a highly realistic dummy unit—exactly the kind you see on display in retail stores—for upcoming product photos or videos. I will supply the rough design files so you can refine, fabricate, and finish the model. Surface quality is critical: the body, hinge area, cameras, buttons, and bezel all have to stand up to close-up shots without betraying that it is a mock-up. Functionally, the hinge must fold smoothly and every external button should move convincingly, though no electronics are required. Preferred workflow is up to you—CNC, high-resolution SLA, multi-material FDM, or a combination—so long as the result feels solid in hand and the gap at the fold aligns cleanly. A realistic screen graphic or dummy glass layer would be a plus. Deliverables • One fully assembled, photo-ready dummy phone that folds and has working buttons • Any updated CAD or build notes created during the process • A short video clip proving the hinge action before shipping Ship the finished piece safely packaged to my address (to be provided after award). I’m looking to get started right away and can answer technical questions or supply extra reference images as soon as we connect.

opportunities.title: Taxi Service Website Development
opportunities.description: I run a small auto-taxi business focused on local city rides and I need a clean, fast website that lets potential passengers do two things before anything else: see my phone number instantly and click a WhatsApp button to start a chat. A built-in price estimator is also essential so visitors can check an approximate fare before they decide to call. Design can stay simple—one to three pages is fine—but it has to look good on mobile because most customers will be on their phones. If you can add a lightweight price calculator (distance-based or zone-based; I’m open to suggestions) and prominent “Call Now” and “Message on WhatsApp” buttons, the core job is done. Online booking forms are not required right now, though I may add that later. Deliverables: • Responsive website (HTML/CSS/JS or a lightweight CMS) • Fare estimator integrated and tested • Click-to-call and WhatsApp chat links placed prominently • Basic SEO setup for city-ride keywords • Hand-off with all source files and brief instructions for small text or fare updates Once it’s live I’ll handle hosting and domain myself; just point me to the best setup. Let me know what tech stack you prefer and any content you’ll need from me to get started.

opportunities.title: MS Teams to Zendesk Ticketing Automation
opportunities.description: Brief: Teams Customer Chasers → Zendesk Automation Oct 21, 2026 · @Edwin Objective Automatically turn customer chasers posted in Microsoft Teams group chats into tracked, prioritised actions on the matching Zendesk ticket. Agents keep working only from Zendesk; Teams becomes one more signal feeding the operational queue. Today, chasers arrive in Teams and must be spotted, matched and acted on manually. The target behaviour: customer chases in Teams → the right ticket is identified from PNR, ticket number or subject → it is marked as chased → it rises in a dedicated Zendesk view. Architecture Customer chaser in Teams → automation captures message → extracts PNR / ticket no. → searches Zendesk → matches ticket → updates it via Zendesk API → native Zendesk trigger → Customer Chasers view → agent action. • Why not the standard Zendesk for Teams app: it lets agents view, create and update tickets in Teams, but does not auto-match chasers or reprioritise tickets. • Division of labour: the automation performs the external Teams → Zendesk update; native Zendesk triggers handle routing and priority afterwards. Zendesk warns against triggers calling webhooks back into the same ticket (race conditions). • Message capture: every new customer message in the relevant Teams group chats must be captured in near real time, through a dedicated operations/service Teams account that is a member of every customer chat. • Identity: OAuth credentials on a dedicated integration identity for production, never personal credentials. Zendesk setup (before building the flow) Custom field Type Purpose Teams Chaser Checkbox Flags tickets chased on Teams Teams Chaser Count Number Chaser events received Last Teams Chaser Date/time Latest chase; drives duplicate suppression Teams Match Status Dropdown Auto Matched / Manual Match / Unmatched PNR Text Matching key (confirm it already exists) Tags: teams_chaser (matched), teams_unmatched_chaser (exceptions). Add tags additively so existing tags are not overwritten. Views: • Customer Chasers — Teams Chaser = Yes. Columns: Ticket ID, Subject, PNR, Status, Assignee, Chaser Count, Last Chaser. Grouped 3+ chasers, then 1–2, then normal queue; normal SLA order within each. • Unmatched Teams Chasers — tag teams_unmatched_chaser. The safety net. Automation requirements For every new customer message, the automation must: 1. Capture the message from the customer Teams group chat as it arrives. 2. Clean it to plain text (strip Teams HTML formatting). 3. Extract the PNR: the 6 characters after PNR:, spaces removed (e.g. PNR: ENIPEC → ENIPEC). Version 1 handles explicit PNR: only. 4. Extract the ticket number after TKTN: (e.g. 978-7493167546). Keep multi-ticket strings such as 160-7363702923/21/22/24 whole for now. 5. Retain the full message text for subject/request-type matching. 6. Search Zendesk tickets for the PNR (Search API, type:ticket ). 7. Evaluate the results (0, 1 or 2+ plausible tickets) against the matching rules below. 8. Update the matched ticket via the Zendesk API: internal note ("public": false — never emailed to the customer), Teams Chaser = Yes, Chaser Count + 1, Last Teams Chaser = now, Match Status = Auto Matched, tag teams_chaser. 9. Hand over to Zendesk: a native trigger surfaces the ticket in Customer Chasers. Example note: CUSTOMER CHASER RECEIVED VIA TEAMS — PNR: ABLSJB — Customer message: Re:[Voyzant] (TIANTAI) PNR:ABLSJB, TKTN:978-7493167546, Inquiry of name correction. Matching rules Principle: when uncertain, don't guess. Key priority: Zendesk ticket # → PNR → ticket number (TKTN) → subject/request type. Situation Action PNR + exact/near-exact subject Auto match PNR + TKTN + request type Auto match PNR + TKTN, one plausible result Auto match PNR + request type, one result Auto match PNR only, multiple tickets Unmatched No PNR Unmatched Multiple plausible results Unmatched Example: PNR KCAQDG returns #18201 Refund, #18244 Involuntary Reissue, #18301 Name Correction. The chaser reads "Inquiry Involuntary Reissue" with TKTN 160-7363702923, so #18244 is selected. To raise match rates, ask customers to use a standard subject: 1589052 | PNR ABC123 | Refund Pending. Unmatched handling No confident match creates an exception ticket (POST /api/v2/tickets), so no chaser is lost. • Retry first: Zendesk search indexing can lag a few minutes. On zero results, wait 2–3 minutes and search once more before raising an exception. • Exception ticket: subject UNMATCHED TEAMS CHASER – ; internal details list PNR, TKTN, customer message, possible matches (e.g. #18201, #18244, #18301), reason, and "ACTION REQUIRED: identify the correct ticket and apply the chaser". Tag teams_unmatched_chaser. • Routing trigger: tag teams_unmatched_chaser → Group = B2B Operations / Floor Support, Priority = High. One named owner per shift. • Exception SLA: 0–5 min Match Required · 5–10 min Match Overdue · 10+ min Supervisor Alert. • Teams alert: if still unhandled, the automation posts to an internal ops group chat: PNR, customer, minutes waiting, number of possible tickets, link to the Unmatched queue. Escalation, duplicates and limitations Escalation tiers (Zendesk triggers on Chaser Count; do not set Urgent on every message): Chaser count Action 1 Tag teams_chaser 2 Appears in Customer Chasers – Priority 3 Priority = High + notify supervisor 4+ Operational escalation Duplicate suppression: if Last Teams Chaser on the same ticket is under 10 minutes old, add the note only; otherwise increment the count. Four messages in three minutes = one chaser event, each still recorded. opportunities.title: SolidWorks/AutoCAD Production Model Drafting
opportunities.description: I have a mechanical product that is moving toward production and now need clean, editable CAD files created in SolidWorks and exported to AutoCAD. The goal is a production-ready model, but at a “basic components and assembly” level—think overall geometry, clear interfaces, and straightforward exploded views rather than full tolerance stacks or exhaustive material call-outs. Here is what I am looking for you to hand over: • A complete 3D assembly in SolidWorks (.sldasm + .sldprt) • 2D assembly and part drawings in both SolidWorks drawing format and DWG for AutoCAD • An exploded view or simple assembly sequence so our shop team can see how everything fits File naming must be logical, each part mated properly, and the assembly should open with no missing references. As long as the model reflects correct fit and function, you can keep the detailing light; I will add tolerances and materials in-house later. If you are comfortable switching between SolidWorks and AutoCAD and can turn around a tidy, well-organized CAD package, let’s get started—I’m ready to review your first draft as soon as it’s ready.

Here is what I am looking for you to hand over: • A complete 3D assembly in SolidWorks (.sldasm + .sldprt) • 2D assembly and part drawings in both SolidWorks drawing format and DWG for AutoCAD • An exploded view or simple assembly sequence so our shop team can see how everything fits File naming must be logical, each part mated properly, and the assembly should open with no missing references. As long as the model reflects correct fit and function, you can keep the detailing light; I will add tolerances and materials in-house later. If you are comfortable switching between SolidWorks and AutoCAD and can turn around a tidy, well-organized CAD package, let’s get started—I’m ready to review your first draft as soon as it’s ready."

opportunities.title: Build Headless Shopify Activewear Store
opportunities.description: Project Posting: Full-Stack Shopify Plus / Headless Developer for D2C Technical Activewear E-Commerce Store (Radian Theme Aesthetic) Project Budget: Fixed Price / Milestone-Based (Competitive market rates based on proven portfolio) Project Timeline: 6 to 8 Weeks Location / Remote: Remote (Global / Asynchronous with regular milestone syncs) Project Overview We are launching a high-performance, direct-to-consumer (D2C) technical activewear brand. We require an elite Full-Stack E-Commerce Developer / Agency to build a lightning-fast, conversion-optimized storefront from the ground up. The aesthetic benchmark for this build is the Radian theme style: an ultra-dark, brutalist industrial look featuring high-contrast monochrome (pitch black #000000, charcoal #121212, sterile white #FFFFFF), flatlock inverted contrast seams, gothic/blackletter typography, and raw utilitarian performance gear presentation. The architecture will leverage Shopify Plus / Headless (Next.js front-end connected to Shopify Admin & Storefront APIs) backed by PostgreSQL/Supabase and automated 3PL logistics middleware. Key Deliverables & Scope of Work 1. Front-End Development (Next.js / Tailwind CSS / Radian Theme UI) Design System Implementation: Build a custom, high-performance UI matching the brutalist industrial aesthetic (pitch black/monochrome, custom typography, zero layout shift). Dynamic PDP (Product Detail Page): Sticky Add-to-Cart bar with instant variant switcher (Size: S-XXL, Fit Profile: Oversized / Compression). Interactive Technical Spec Sheets (GSM weight breakdown, 4-way stretch nylon-mesh fabric details, care instructions). Immersive full-screen media grids and macro photo galleries. PLG & Collection Grids: Lightning-fast product listing pages with instant filtering, sorting, and low-stock badge indicators. 2. Shopify Integration & Backend Architecture Shopify Storefront API Integration: Full headless connection for dynamic cart management, checkout redirection, and inventory sync. Variant Matrix & Bundling: Setup multi-attribute variants and custom kit builder logic (e.g., bundle compression top + 350 GSM joggers with automated bundle discounts). Supabase / PostgreSQL Database Setup: Implement auxiliary data tables for User Fit Lockers (saving height, weight, fit preference), VIP waitlists, and custom customer profiles. 3. Checkout, Payments & Regional Gateways Express Checkout Optimization: Seamless integration for Apple Pay, Google Pay, Shop Pay, and UPI Intent flows (PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm). Payment Gateway Integration: Razorpay / Cashfree integration supporting Credit/Debit Cards, Net Banking, UPI, and verified Cash on Delivery (COD) workflows to mitigate RTO (Return to Origin). Multi-Currency Support: Geo-IP currency detection (INR, USD, EUR, GBP). 4. Logistics, 3PL & Fulfillment Automation Courier Aggregator Middleware: Integrate Shiprocket / Delhivery / Blue Dart APIs. Automated AWB & Manifest Generation: Webhook-driven order routing that triggers label generation and shipping status updates upon payment capture. Branded Tracking & Returns Portals: Custom /pages/track portal for real-time milestone tracking and an automated self-serve return/exchange module. 5. Marketing, Tracking & Performance Optimization Analytics & CAPI: Server-side Meta Conversions API (CAPI) and Google GA4 event tracking (PageView, AddToCart, InitiateCheckout, Purchase). Klaviyo Integration: Abandoned cart flows, browse abandonment, and restock alert webhooks. Performance Benchmark: Deliver a Lighthouse performance score of 95+ with optimized image loading, edge caching, and bot-mitigation rate limiting. Technical Stack Requirements Front-End: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion. Commerce Backend: Shopify Admin GraphQL API, Shopify Storefront API. Database & State: PostgreSQL (Supabase), Redis (Caching & Rate Limiting). Hosting & CDN: Vercel Enterprise, Cloudflare DNS. APIs: Shiprocket/Delhivery logistics APIs, Razorpay/Cashfree payment gateways, Klaviyo, Meta CAPI. Ideal Candidate / Agency Profile Proven Portfolio: Must showcase live Shopify Plus, headless Next.js, or high-end apparel/streetwear/activewear stores with exceptional design execution (dark mode, brutalist, or minimalist luxury aesthetics). API & Webhook Mastery: Deep experience handling complex Shopify webhooks, inventory syncing, and third-party logistics (3PL) API integrations. Performance Obsessed: Demonstrated ability to build blazing-fast web apps with optimized Core Web Vitals. Communication & Code Standards: Clean, well-documented code repositories (GitHub), adherence to strict version control, and transparent milestone reporting. Application Requirements When applying, please provide: Links to 2–3 live, production-grade e-commerce stores you have built (specifically highlighting Next.js/Headless Shopify or high-aesthetic apparel brands). A brief overview of your technical approach to handling headless Shopify architecture and inventory synchronization. Your estimated timeline and milestone breakdown to complete this scope.

opportunities.title: AI CRM to Boost Ceramic Sales
opportunities.description: I run a ceramic manufacturing business in Morbi and my biggest pain-point is missing out on hot enquiries. I want a custom CRM powered by AI that captures leads the moment they appear, nudges them automatically, and keeps my sales team organised so we close more deals—faster. Lead capture must be truly omnichannel: • Website forms and live chat on our corporate site • WhatsApp, Facebook and Instagram messages or lead ads • Dealer enquiries and trade-fair visitor lists • Direct email enquiries that land in our shared inbox Once a lead enters the system the CRM should: • Enrich and score it with AI so high-value prospects surface first • Trigger personalised follow-ups (email or WhatsApp) at smart intervals • Hand the conversation to a human agent when required, logging every touchpoint • Provide a single dashboard with filters for source, status, probability and salesperson • Generate clear reports so I can see which channels and reps are performing best I’m open to the tech stack—whether you prefer a no-code backbone like Zoho/HubSpot customised with scripts, or a ground-up build using Node, Python, or similar—as long as integrations are stable and the UX is lightweight enough for field reps on mobile. Deliverables I need to sign off: 1. Working cloud CRM with all above channels live in production 2. AI scoring & automated follow-up workflows demonstrated on test data 3. Sales dashboard with exportable reports 4. One-hour handover session plus concise user guide When you apply, just share past work that proves you’ve built multi-channel CRMs or similar marketing automations before. No lengthy proposals—let your portfolio speak. If your experience lines up, we’ll jump on a quick call to map timelines and milestones.

opportunities.title: Custom WordPress Affiliate Deals Website
opportunities.description: WordPress Developer Needed for a Deals & Savings Website I am looking for an experienced WordPress developer to build a modern, responsive, affiliate deals website featuring discounts from multiple retailers. I already have a homepage design reference. I need you to implement the existing design, not create a new one from scratch. Required Features * Custom WordPress website that closely follows my design reference. * User-friendly admin dashboard to manually add, edit, and manage deals without coding. * Custom deal fields: product name, image, retailer, current price, original price, discount percentage, SKU, affiliate link, category, and expiration date. * Automatically display published deals on the homepage, relevant retailer pages, category pages, and search results. * Automatically hide expired deals from active listings. * Individual product deal pages with a clear “View Deal” button. * Search and filtering by retailer and category. * Mobile-friendly design, SEO optimization, and fast loading speed. * Affiliate disclosure and outgoing affiliate click tracking. Future Expansion The website should be structured to support future affiliate API integrations and deal automation. Automation is not required for the initial launch and should not be included in this quote. Requirements * Strong experience with custom WordPress development. * Ability to create custom functionality beyond standard themes and plugins. * Full website ownership, source code, and administrator access. * Deployment, testing, and basic documentation included.

opportunities.description: I have a ready-to-share collection of photos and videos that sit firmly in the “entertainment and fun” space—not adult-only, just light-hearted material for people looking to relax and smile. My goal is to circulate this package online and make it easy for genuinely interested viewers to reach me through WhatsApp, where I’m available 24/7. Here’s what I’m looking for you to handle: • Shape a simple but attractive online presentation of the album (Google Drive, private web page, or a similar straightforward host—whatever you recommend). • Craft concise, engaging copy that highlights what the audience can expect without giving everything away. • Set up a friction-free “click to chat” WhatsApp link or button so inquiries funnel directly to my number. • Suggest two or three traffic channels (social media posts, small paid boosts, or niche forums) that suit fun, non-adult visual content and outline the first actions I should take there. I already have every image and video edited, titled, and sorted; no production work is needed—just packaging and promotion. If you’re comfortable connecting content creators with the right audience and can move quickly, let’s talk and get this live.

opportunities.title: Digital Trifold Brochure PDF Creation
opportunities.description: I have a fully designed, six-panel tri-fold brochure, along with an existing interactive HTML prototype that already displays the panels in the correct sequence. I am not looking for a new brochure design or a standard PDF conversion. I'm looking for someone who can take my existing artwork and HTML prototype and create a polished, interactive digital brochure that opens and closes naturally, like a physical tri-fold leaflet. What I need: The brochure should initially display the front cover. On the first click, the cover should open to reveal two panels side by side. On the second click, it should unfold fully to reveal the three inside panels. On the final click, it should close to display the back cover. The folding movements should look smooth and realistic. All existing artwork, text, photographs and branding must remain unchanged. The finished brochure must work on desktop and mobile devices. It must be accessible through a simple web link that I can share by email, WhatsApp or LinkedIn. I would like the finished HTML/source files so I can make future updates. I can provide the original PDF artwork and the existing working HTML prototype, so the developer will not need to start from scratch. Budget: €30 initially. Please advise if the animation requirements make this unrealistic. I'm looking for someone experienced in HTML5/CSS/JavaScript animation who can show examples of similar interactive projects. Please include at least one example of past work relevant to this project.

opportunities.title: Automatización NBA 1Q en Google Sheets
opportunities.description: TÍTULO DEL PROYECTO: Google Sheets automatizado con API NBA: tablas por cuarto, cálculo de total y hándicap del 1er cuarto DESCRIPCIÓN DEL PROYECTO: Necesito un archivo de Google Sheets totalmente automatizado para analizar apuestas de la NBA, centrado en el primer cuarto (1Q). No tengo conocimientos técnicos. El freelancer debe encargarse de toda la configuración, conexión, fórmulas y puesta en marcha. Mi único trabajo diario será abrir el archivo, pulsar actualizar, escribir la línea de la casa de apuestas y leer el resultado. No quiero copiar y pegar datos ni tocar fórmulas. PARTE 1: CONEXIÓN AUTOMÁTICA A UNA API GRATUITA DE LA NBA Usar una API gratuita y estable, preferiblemente ESPN (endpoints públicos sin clave) o balldontlie.io (tier gratuito). El freelancer puede elegir la que considere más fiable y debe documentar la URL usada. Al pulsar un botón o abrir el archivo, el script de Apps Script debe refrescar automáticamente estas tablas: 1. Partidos del día: equipos, fecha, hora y estado del partido. 2. Boxscore por cuarto: puntos de cada equipo en 1Q, 2Q, 3Q y 4Q. Es imprescindible que traiga los puntos de ambos equipos en cada partido, no solo de uno. 3. Estadísticas por jugador: jugador, equipo, minutos, puntos y faltas, filtrable por cuarto si la fuente lo permite. 4. Tabla de referencia de los 30 equipos, generada automáticamente desde la API o precargada una sola vez. No debo escribirla a mano. PARTE 2: CÁLCULOS AUTOMÁTICOS DEL PRIMER CUARTO El freelancer debe dejar montadas las fórmulas para que, dados los últimos 15 partidos de cada equipo, la hoja calcule sola: · Media de puntos anotados en 1Q por el Equipo A. · Media de puntos permitidos en 1Q por el Equipo A (puntos del rival en esos mismos partidos). · Media de puntos anotados en 1Q por el Equipo B. · Media de puntos permitidos en 1Q por el Equipo B. · Puntos esperados de A = (media anotada de A + media permitida de B) / 2. · Puntos esperados de B = (media anotada de B + media permitida de A) / 2. · Total 1Q esperado = puntos esperados de A + puntos esperados de B. · Hándicap 1Q esperado = puntos esperados de A − puntos esperados de B. La ventana móvil debe ser configurable (por defecto 15 partidos), para poder cambiarla sin tocar fórmulas. PARTE 3: COMPARACIÓN CON LA LÍNEA DE LA CASA Y SEMÁFORO DE VALOR En una hoja de Resultados debe haber: · Una columna vacía para que yo escriba la línea de Total 1Q de la casa de apuestas. · Una columna vacía para que yo escriba la línea de Hándicap 1Q de la casa de apuestas. · Una celda que calcule la diferencia entre mi estimación y la línea. · Un semáforo automático con formato condicional: verde si la diferencia absoluta es de 2 puntos o más (POSIBLE VALOR), rojo si es menor (SIN VALOR). Lo mismo para el total y para el hándicap. PARTE 4: INTERFAZ SENCILLA Una hoja Resultados donde se vea claramente, para el partido del día: · Equipos que juegan. · Total 1Q esperado. · Hándicap 1Q esperado. · Línea de la casa (la escribo yo). · Diferencia y semáforo de valor. · Alertas si falta una estrella, un pívot clave o un creador de juego, si la fuente de datos lo permite. El resto de hojas pueden ser de datos, configuración o históricos, pero no quiero tener que tocarlas. PARTE 5: ENTREGABLES · Archivo de Google Sheets completamente funcional y compartido con permiso de edición. · Script de Apps Script incluido y documentado. · Breve guía de uso de 1 a 2 páginas: cómo actualizar, dónde escribir la línea, qué significa cada columna y cada semáforo. · Prueba de funcionamiento con al menos un partido real: que el total y hándicap del 1Q calculados coincidan con los datos oficiales, y que el semáforo responda correctamente al cambiar la línea. · Video de 2 minutos o llamada corta mostrando cómo se actualiza el archivo, dónde se escribe la línea y cómo cambia el semáforo. REQUISITOS DEL FREELANCER · Experiencia demostrable en Google Sheets, Apps Script, conexión a APIs y JSON. · Conocimiento de la NBA y de mercados de apuestas como totales, hándicap y primer cuarto es un plus. · Debe encargarse de toda la implementación técnica. Yo no puedo programar ni configurar conexiones. · Debe entregar el sistema estable y documentado para que no requiera mantenimiento por mi parte. PRESUPUESTO Y PLAZO · Presupuesto orientativo: 80–150 USD. · Plazo deseado: 1–2 semanas. · Acepto hitos de pago: uno al validar la conexión y las tablas de datos, y otro al entregar los cálculos del 1Q, el semáforo y la guía final. NOTA No busco un producto genérico de apuestas, sino una herramienta concreta para el primer cuarto de la NBA. No espero garantías de rentabilidad, solo una herramienta técnica bien construida, estable y sin mantenimiento por mi parte. Si la fuente de datos cambia en el futuro, el freelancer debe dejarlo documentado para poder actualizarlo fácilmente. HABILIDADES REQUERIDAS Google Sheets, Apps Script, API, JSON, Sports Betting, NBA, Data Automation.

opportunities.verbatim_request: "TÍTULO DEL PROYECTO: Google Sheets automatizado con API NBA: tablas por cuarto, cálculo de total y hándicap del 1er cuarto DESCRIPCIÓN DEL PROYECTO: Necesito un archivo de Google Sheets totalmente automatizado para analizar apuestas de la NBA, centrado en el primer cuarto (1Q). No tengo conocimientos técnicos. El freelancer debe encargarse de toda la configuración, conexión, fórmulas y puesta en marcha. Mi único trabajo diario será abrir el archivo, pulsar actualizar, escribir la línea de la casa de apuestas y leer el resultado. No quiero copiar y pegar datos ni tocar fórmulas. PARTE 1: CONEXIÓN AUTOMÁTICA A UNA API GRATUITA DE LA NBA Usar una API gratuita y estable, preferiblemente ESPN (endpoints públicos sin clave) o balldontlie.io (tier gratuito). El freelancer puede elegir la que considere más fiable y debe documentar la URL usada. Al pulsar un botón o abrir el archivo, el script de Apps Script debe refrescar automáticamente estas tablas: 1. Partidos del día: equipos, fecha, hora y estado del partido. 2. Boxscore por cuarto: puntos de cada equipo en 1Q, 2Q, 3Q y 4Q. Es imprescindible que traiga los puntos de ambos equipos en cada partido, no solo de uno. 3. Estadísticas por jugador: jugador, equipo, minutos, puntos y faltas, filtrable por cuarto si la fuente lo permite. 4. Tabla de referencia de los 30 equipos, generada automáticamente desde la API o precargada una sola vez. No debo escribirla a mano. PARTE 2: CÁLCULOS AUTOMÁTICOS DEL PRIMER CUARTO El freelancer debe dejar montadas las fórmulas para que, dados los últimos 15 partidos de cada equipo, la hoja calcule sola: · Media de puntos anotados en 1Q por el Equipo A. · Media de puntos permitidos en 1Q por el Equipo A (puntos del rival en esos mismos partidos). · Media de puntos anotados en 1Q por el Equipo B. · Media de puntos permitidos en 1Q por el Equipo B. · Puntos esperados de A = (media anotada de A + media permitida de B) / 2. · Puntos esperados de B = (media anotada de B + media permitida de A) / 2. · Total 1Q esperado = puntos esperados de A + puntos esperados de B. · Hándicap 1Q esperado = puntos esperados de A − puntos esperados de B. La ventana móvil debe ser configurable (por defecto 15 partidos), para poder cambiarla sin tocar fórmulas. PARTE 3: COMPARACIÓN CON LA LÍNEA DE LA CASA Y SEMÁFORO DE VALOR En una hoja de Resultados debe haber: · Una columna vacía para que yo escriba la línea de Total 1Q de la casa de apuestas. · Una columna vacía para que yo escriba la línea de Hándicap 1Q de la casa de apuestas. · Una celda que calcule la diferencia entre mi estimación y la línea. · Un semáforo automático con formato condicional: verde si la diferencia absoluta es de 2 puntos o más (POSIBLE VALOR), rojo si es menor (SIN VALOR). Lo mismo para el total y para el hándicap. PARTE 4: INTERFAZ SENCILLA Una hoja Resultados donde se vea claramente, para el partido del día: · Equipos que juegan. · Total 1Q esperado. · Hándicap 1Q esperado. · Línea de la casa (la escribo yo). · Diferencia y semáforo de valor. · Alertas si falta una estrella, un pívot clave o un creador de juego, si la fuente de datos lo permite. El resto de hojas pueden ser de datos, configuración o históricos, pero no quiero tener que tocarlas. PARTE 5: ENTREGABLES · Archivo de Google Sheets completamente funcional y compartido con permiso de edición. · Script de Apps Script incluido y documentado. · Breve guía de uso de 1 a 2 páginas: cómo actualizar, dónde escribir la línea, qué significa cada columna y cada semáforo. · Prueba de funcionamiento con al menos un partido real: que el total y hándicap del 1Q calculados coincidan con los datos oficiales, y que el semáforo responda correctamente al cambiar la línea. · Video de 2 minutos o llamada corta mostrando cómo se actualiza el archivo, dónde se escribe la línea y cómo cambia el semáforo. REQUISITOS DEL FREELANCER · Experiencia demostrable en Google Sheets, Apps Script, conexión a APIs y JSON. · Conocimiento de la NBA y de mercados de apuestas como totales, hándicap y primer cuarto es un plus. · Debe encargarse de toda la implementación técnica. Yo no puedo programar ni configurar conexiones. · Debe entregar el sistema estable y documentado para que no requiera mantenimiento por mi parte. PRESUPUESTO Y PLAZO · Presupuesto orientativo: 80–150 USD. · Plazo deseado: 1–2 semanas. · Acepto hitos de pago: uno al validar la conexión y las tablas de datos, y otro al entregar los cálculos del 1Q, el semáforo y la guía final. NOTA No busco un producto genérico de apuestas, sino una herramienta concreta para el primer cuarto de la NBA. No espero garantías de rentabilidad, solo una herramienta técnica bien construida, estable y sin mantenimiento por mi parte. Si la fuente de datos cambia en el futuro, el freelancer debe dejarlo documentado para poder actualizarlo fácilmente. HABILIDADES REQUERIDAS Google Sheets, Apps Script, API, JSON, Sports Betting, NBA, Data Automation."

opportunities.title: STL Model Reshape for Printing
opportunities.description: I have an existing 3D model in STL format that needs several changes before it will be ready for the printer. The piece must be resized to exact specifications, certain features have to be added or removed, and the surfaces need a material-quality pass so I can generate realistic colour previews prior to fabrication. Your task is to open the current STL, carry out those geometric edits cleanly, refine any visible texture detail, and return a watertight, non-manifold-free file that slices without errors. Feel free to work in the software of your choice—Blender, Z-Brush, Fusion 360, SolidWorks, or similar—as long as the final delivery meets the following acceptance criteria: • Updated, print-ready STL at the correct scale • Clean topology: no holes, inverted normals or intersecting shells • Added/removed features blended seamlessly into the mesh • Optional high-res OBJ (or equivalent) with improved material/texture data for preview renders Let me know the tools you plan to use and your expected turnaround time, and we can get started right away.

opportunities.description: I have a steady pipeline of marketing and narrative pieces that call for cinematic, photoreal 3D animation. On each project you will be responsible for building or refining scenes, applying realistic textures, setting up dramatic lighting, choreographing camera moves, and delivering final, fully rendered footage that matches an approved reference. Strong storytelling instincts are just as important as technical mastery. If you work in Blender, Maya, Cinema 4D, 3ds Max, Houdini, After Effects, Fusion, or a comparable toolset, that’s fine—the key is consistency in quality and the ability to hit the look we’re after every time. When you reply, please include: • A link to your most relevant 3D video reel • The primary software and render engine you use • Your typical price range or rate structure and average turnaround per minute of finished video We can begin with a paid test clip; after that, successful deliveries will roll straight into additional projects. Clear communication, reliable deadlines, and flawless renders are the hallmarks I’m looking to maintain over the long term.

opportunities.title: Figura 3D caricatura personalizada
opportunities.description: Necesito un modelo 3D listo para impresión que represente una figura decorativa basada en las fotos que te entregaré. Quiero un estilo simple, caricaturesco y amigable, sin llegar a la hiper-realidad: proporciones exageradas, rasgos simplificados y una pose dinámica que destaque la personalidad del sujeto. Te enviaré varias imágenes de referencia (persona, mascota u objeto) para que captes los puntos clave y mantengas la esencia. Trabajo principalmente con impresoras FDM, así que el diseño debe contemplar: • Partes optimizadas para evitar soportes excesivos. • Grosores mínimos adecuados para una boquilla de 0,4 mm. • Separación clara de piezas, si fuera necesario para prevenir warping o facilitar el pintado. Entregarás: 1. Archivo fuente editable (Blender, ZBrush o similar). 2. STL limpio, escalado a 150 mm de altura. 3. Capturas o pequeño turno de revisión por si hay que ajustar expresión, pose o base. Busco alguien que disfrute del estilo cartoon y tenga experiencia exportando modelos sólidos, sin mallas abiertas ni errores de geometría. Si ya imprimiste tus propios diseños, menciona qué software usas para confirmar compatibilidad con Cura/PrusaSlicer. Quedo atento a tu propuesta y a un pequeño portafolio que demuestre trabajos similares.

opportunities.title: Launch Profitable Halloween Ad Campaigns
opportunities.description: Project Brief: Facebook Ads & Google Ads for Halloween Products I’m looking for an experienced e-commerce advertising specialist to help launch and manage campaigns for my Shopify store targeting the US market. My store currently focuses on 3D-printed graphic T-shirts, and I’m planning to introduce five Halloween products to expand the catalog and generate additional sales. Project Requirements: Review and evaluate all five products, especially products #2 and #4. Develop and manage Facebook/Instagram Ads campaigns, with Google Ads as a potential secondary channel. Assist with advertising account setup, Shopify integration, and conversion tracking. Recommend effective ad creatives, audiences, and testing strategies. Monitor performance and optimize campaigns based on sales and profitability. Target Market: United States, subject to platform targeting policies. Planned Weekly Ad Budget: Meta Ads: $4,500 Google Ads: $2,000 The budget is flexible and will be adjusted based on initial testing results. I also have a potential US-based supplier offering 3–5-day delivery and would appreciate your advice on balancing shipping speed and product costs. What I’m Looking For: Someone with proven e-commerce advertising experience, strong analytical skills, transparent pricing, and the ability to provide practical recommendations. Please share relevant case studies, your weekly management fee, any additional costs, and your proposed strategy for evaluating and launching the products. Ideally, I’d like to get the initial setup and product evaluation underway within the next 24–48 hours, depending on account access and platform requirements. My goal is to identify promising products, launch efficiently, and generate profitable sales through a data-driven advertising strategy.

opportunities.title: Cinematic 3D Video Creator Needed
opportunities.description: My upcoming slate of marketing and brand films calls for a partner who can take a storyboard and turn it into a fully-realised, cinematic 3D sequence with characters and environments that feel alive on screen. You should be comfortable handling every stage of the shot—from blocking the scene, lighting, texturing and animating, right through to the final render and post-polish—while carefully matching any reference footage I supply. For each project I will provide: • a written brief, mood-boards and timing references • any existing assets or logos that must be incorporated • the delivery schedule and required resolution (usually 4K) What I need from you: • a short reel or links that highlight comparable cinematic work • the primary software you work in (Blender, Maya, Cinema 4D, Houdini, 3ds Max, etc.) and any plug-ins you rely on • your ballpark price or day rate for projects of this scale Consistency is key; I’m aiming to build a long-term collaboration, so reliability, clear communication and a passion for visual storytelling count just as much as technical skill. If you thrive on crafting movie-like moments in 3D and can keep quality high across multiple releases, let’s talk about the first scene.

opportunities.title: Prueba y ajuste formulario Wix
opportunities.description: Tengo una web en Wix (editor Harmony) con una colección del CMS llamada “Talentos” que alimenta la página Talentos y el Directorio de Talentos. Necesito que los datos y la foto que los usuarios envían en el formulario de Registro de Artistas lleguen a esa colección. * Situación actual: - Los formularios funcionan y me llega el aviso por correo. - Los envíos NO pasan al CMS. El soporte de Wix me confirmó por escrito que Harmony no permite vincular de forma nativa los archivos o imágenes de Wix Forms con colecciones del CMS. - En Harmony no tengo modo desarrollador ni Velo. Propuesta de solución (abierto a otras mejores): formulario ---- automatización (Make o Zapier) ---- CMS. No quiero migrar a Wix Studio salvo que sea imprescindible y se me justifique técnicamente, con presupuesto previo. * FASE 1. Prueba de viabilidad (1-2 horas, precio fijo). Antes de hacer nada más, necesito comprobar que esto es posible en mi sitio. Objetivo: Enviar un formulario de prueba y verificar que el texto Y la imagen llegan a un elemento de la colección “Talentos”. Al terminar, quiero un informe breve con: - Si funciona o no, y por qué. - Cómo se resuelve el tema de la imagen. - Si Harmony lo permite o hace falta otra vía (y cuál). - Precio cerrado y plazo de la fase 2. * FASE 2. Implantación (solo se la fase 1 es positiva). 1. Cada envío (texto+imagen) crea un elemento en “Talentos”. 2. La imagen se guarda correctamente en el campo de imagen. 3. Revisar que la página de Talentos y el Directorio apunten a esa colección y muestren foto, disciplina, categoría, email y texto. 4. Guía breve de cómo funciona, para poder mantenerlo yo. * Condiciones: - Alcance cerrado a este flujo, con presupuesto fijo por escrito para cada fase. - Pruebas en una copia del sitio. - Valorable experiencia demostrable con Wix CMS y Make/Zapier (portfolio o reseñas). Si te interesa, indícame precio de cada fase, plazo y cómo lo harías. Si crees que no es posible en Harmony, dímelo claramente y explica por qué. Gracias, Miguel Angel.

opportunities.title: Mecanismo Simple en Inventor y AutoCAD
opportunities.description: Necesito un mecanismo sencillo modelado íntegramente en Autodesk Inventor. Quiero recibir: • El archivo nativo de Inventor con sus componentes bien nombrados y organizados. • El despiece animado o explosionado para visualizar cómo se arma. • Planos 2D en formato DWG listos para imprimir en AutoCAD, con vistas, cotas básicas y lista de materiales. Aún no he definido el tipo exacto de mecanismo ni el material principal, así que agradezco que me sugieras soluciones factibles (palancas, engranajes, sistemas de sujeción, etc.) y me indiques qué material resultaría más apropiado según tu propuesta. El diseño debe ser práctico y fácil de fabricar con medios convencionales. Valoro que me expliques brevemente tu enfoque, plazos estimados y ejemplos previos realizados en Inventor y AutoCAD.
